title: Why Hunter-Gatherers Have Richer Gut Bacteria
hook: Your gut is a ghost town compared to a hunter-gatherer's.
closing: Civilization made our food safer and our guts emptier.
question: How much fiber did you eat today?

segments.say: The Hadza of Tanzania carry about 730 gut bacteria species. The average American has fewer than half that.
The difference is fiber -- the Hadza eat 150 grams a day, ten times what the average American eats.
On top of that, a third of US antibiotic prescriptions aren't even necessary, and each one can wipe out gut diversity.
